description: This file defines an interface 'ResultInterface' in the AWS SDK for PHP, representing a generic result object returned from AWS service operations, including methods for conversion, key access, and search functionality.

classes.name: ResultInterface
classes.description: Interface representing a generic AWS result object with methods for string conversion, array conversion, key existence, key retrieval, and JMESPath search.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Provides debug information about the result object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts the result object to an array.

methods.name: hasKey
methods.description: Checks if the model contains a key by name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key value from the result model.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Runs a JMESPath query on the result content.
